originalSentence: Jina likes jazz. I like jazz, too.
instruction: so 도치를 이용해 한 문장으로 나타내기
options: Jina likes jazz, and so I do.
Jina likes jazz, and so am I.
Jina likes jazz, and neither do I.
Jina likes jazz, and so do I.
explanation: 일반동사 현재 긍정문에 동의할 때 so + do + 주어를 써요.
